description: This file implements the basic container object functions for the CCSP CWMP Session Object, including creation, removal, enrollment of objects, and initialization. It defines core methods and handles resource management for the session object in the CCSP CWMP protocol architecture.

classes.name: CCSP_CWMP_SESSION_OBJECT
classes.description: The main session object managing CWMP protocol interactions, timers, connection, and associated interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CcspCwmpsoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs a new CCSP CWMP Session Object, initializing its core structure and function pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the session object, freeing resources and unregistering timers and interfaces.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Enrolls and initializes child objects such as timers, connections, and interfaces required by the session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmpsoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the session object, setting default values, function pointers, and preparing internal state.
